note: Every station the envelope extends, classified by where the extension lands: on ground another stroke of the same shape already sews under the symmetric rails (an ESCAPE: the far ray ran along a meeting arm) or on unsewn ground (a genuine reach). Each logo at its own width and garment, max_colors=6, the shipped defaults otherwise. 'shipped_envelope' is the engine before the sibling rule (main at d59ff556), 'with_rule' after it, as shipped: the sibling's half-width is the median of the width field at tenths of its spine's arc length plus the pull (an earlier variant read the field at 16 vertex indices without the pull: 157 / 46 / 111). Instrument: digitizer/tools/envelope_escapes.py (a trace hook on _rail_points reads every station's symmetric width and per-side offsets; the symmetric arm's returned rails are rasterized per stroke at 20 px/mm; an extension is an escape when at least half of it lies on another stroke's satin).
